title: The Sprouting Lid on the Jar
youtube_title: The Sprouting Lid on the Jar | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Kito wants to check on a sprouting jar with its cloth lid before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Kito leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
